name: Blade of Eternity
description: A legendary sword forged from celestial steel and infused with the essence of time itself. This masterpiece weapon grows stronger with each battle, learning from the wielder's combat style.

special_materials.description: Steel forged in the heart of a dying star
The still-beating heart of an ancient dragon

unique_properties.description: Damage adapts to enemy weaknesses (+50% vs vulnerabilities)
10% chance to slow time during critical moments
Intimidates nearby enemies, reducing their attack speed
